rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already has user-hidden markers, the local eye, and Zigbee overlay mapping. Hidden raw rows can be mistaken for absent placement. This task repairs visibility agreement and preserves the independent source/registry/route diagnostics without adding a new setting or scan.

summary.ru: Диагностика Zigbee различает скрытые и отсутствующие значки; показ скрытых согласован со связями.
summary.en: Zigbee diagnostics distinguish hidden and missing markers and follow local hidden-device display.

golden.reason: New case reveals a saved hidden child through the native eye and paints its confirmed link to an existing LED router. No existing baseline change is authorised.
